description: This Java source file defines the CredentialsClientImpl class, a client implementation for Hono's Credentials API using Vertx-Proton. It includes methods for creating clients, retrieving credentials, handling responses, and managing AMQP links.

classes.name: CredentialsClientImpl
classes.description: A Vertx-Proton based client for Hono's Credentials API, implementing methods to retrieve credentials and manage AMQP links.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves credentials of a specified type and authId, optionally with client context and tracing span.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new CredentialsClient for a tenant, optionally with cache provider and link close handlers.

methods.name: getTargetAddress
methods.description: Constructs the AMQP target address for the credentials endpoint for a given tenant.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the endpoint name for credentials API.

methods.name: createMessageId
methods.description: Generates a unique message ID for requests.

methods.name: getResult
methods.description: Processes the response from the credentials service, parsing payload or handling errors.
